info.name: AI Expense Splitter API
info.description: Run this collection top to bottom (Collection Runner or Newman). It registers two throwaway users, then exercises every module with assertions. Amounts are integer paise.

item.name: Forgot password (never reveals if email exists)

exec: pm.test("contains the new group", () => pm.expect(Boolean(j.groups.some(g => g.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("groupId")))).to.be.true);

item.name: Equal split: A pays 3000.00 for A+B
Shares split: B pays 900.00 (1 share : 2 shares)
Exact split that does not add up -> 400

exec: pm.test("2 per page, 4 total", () => pm.expect(Boolean(j.expenses.length === 2 && j.total === 4)).to.be.true);
pm.test("net balances sum to exactly 0", () => pm.expect(Boolean(j.balances.reduce((s, b) => s + b.net_balance, 0) === 0)).to.be.true);

item.name: Payer cannot confirm their own payment -> 403
Balances still sum to zero after settlement

exec: pm.test("sum is 0", () => pm.expect(Boolean(j.balances.reduce((s, b) => s + b.net_balance, 0) === 0)).to.be.true);

item.name: Create overall budget (₹1.00, will be exceeded)

exec: pm.test("1 budget with utilisation", () => pm.expect(Boolean(j.budgets.length === 1 && j.budgets[0].utilization_percent >= 100)).to.be.true);

item.name: 10. AI (needs OPENAI_API_KEY on the server for 200s)

exec: pm.test("200 with an answer, or 503 when no OpenAI key is configured", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 503]));

item.name: Chat with a "system" history role is refused -> 400
A group with expenses cannot be deleted -> 409
